name: Quick Time Battle
description: Timed WASD + Enter challenges on hero attacks scale damage; press a key before an enemy hit to dodge it.

defaultParameters.name: Multipliers
defaultParameters.description: Damage multipliers for OOPS, Good, Great, Excellent, Perfect.

defaultParameters.name: Fail On Miss
defaultParameters.description: A failed challenge really misses. Off: it only uses the first multiplier.

defaultParameters.name: Perfect Crit
defaultParameters.description: A Perfect forces a critical hit.

defaultParameters.name: Damage At Slash Frame
defaultParameters.description: Damage lands on the attacker's slash frame.

defaultParameters.name: Tiering
defaultParameters.description: Skills named ... 1/2/3 get harder challenges.

defaultParameters.name: Popup Linger
defaultParameters.description: Milliseconds damage numbers stay on screen.

defaultParameters.name: UI Style
defaultParameters.description: pixel (chunky, matches the engine) or polished (smooth).

defaultParameters.name: Pixel Size
defaultParameters.description: Screen pixels per UI pixel in pixel style. 0 = automatic.

defaultParameters.name: UI Scale
defaultParameters.description: Size of the challenge UI.

defaultParameters.name: Prompts Over Head
defaultParameters.description: Prompts float above the active hero instead of mid-screen.

defaultParameters.name: Hint Uses
defaultParameters.description: Text hints fade after this many uses per challenge type. 0 = never show.

defaultParameters.name: Beat Pulse
defaultParameters.description: Prompt bubble pulses with each tick sound.

defaultParameters.name: Impact Freeze Scale
defaultParameters.description: Length of the freeze on the slash frame. 0 = off.

defaultParameters.name: Effects Scale
defaultParameters.description: Size of particles and bursts.

defaultParameters.name: Sound
defaultParameters.description: Synthesized sounds.

defaultParameters.name: Volume
defaultParameters.description: Sound volume, 0 to 1.

defaultParameters.name: Defense Enabled
defaultParameters.description: Press a key just before an enemy hit to dodge it.

defaultParameters.name: Defense Window Frames
defaultParameters.description: Frames (60 fps) before the hit in which a press counts.

defaultParameters.name: Defense Cooldown
defaultParameters.description: Seconds before another dodge press is accepted.

defaultParameters.name: Defense Slide Distance
defaultParameters.description: Sidestep distance.

defaultParameters.name: Defense Slide Duration
defaultParameters.description: Sidestep duration in seconds.

defaultParameters.name: Ranged Hero 1
defaultParameters.description: Variable holding a ranged hero's ID. That hero never runs up to the enemy. Empty = unused.

defaultParameters.name: Ranged Hero 2
defaultParameters.description: Variable holding a ranged hero's ID. That hero never runs up to the enemy. Empty = unused.

defaultParameters.name: Ranged Hero 3
defaultParameters.description: Variable holding a ranged hero's ID. That hero never runs up to the enemy. Empty = unused.

defaultParameters.name: Ranged Hero 4
defaultParameters.description: Variable holding a ranged hero's ID. That hero never runs up to the enemy. Empty = unused.

defaultParameters.name: Ranged Hero 5
defaultParameters.description: Variable holding a ranged hero's ID. That hero never runs up to the enemy. Empty = unused.

defaultParameters.name: Ranged Hero 6
defaultParameters.description: Variable holding a ranged hero's ID. That hero never runs up to the enemy. Empty = unused.

defaultParameters.name: Ranged Hero 7
defaultParameters.description: Variable holding a ranged hero's ID. That hero never runs up to the enemy. Empty = unused.

defaultParameters.name: Ranged Hero 8
defaultParameters.description: Variable holding a ranged hero's ID. That hero never runs up to the enemy. Empty = unused.

defaultParameters.name: Default Challenge
defaultParameters.description: JSON. Challenge for any damaging skill with no other entry.

defaultParameters.name: Class Challenges
defaultParameters.description: JSON. Class ID -> {default:{...}, skills:{id:{...}}}.

defaultParameters.name: Hero Challenges
defaultParameters.description: JSON. Hero ID -> {default:{...}, skills:{id:{...}}}. Overrides class.

defaultParameters.name: Skill Challenges
defaultParameters.description: JSON. Skill ID -> challenge, or false for none. Beats hero/class defaults.

defaultParameters.name: Element Themes
defaultParameters.description: JSON. Element ID -> theme.

defaultParameters.name: Name Themes
defaultParameters.description: JSON list of {match: regex, theme}. Used when a skill has no element.

defaultParameters.name: Advanced Overrides
defaultParameters.description: JSON merged over everything else.

defaultParameters.name: Debug
defaultParameters.description: Log choices to the console and the battle log.

defaultParameters.name: Battle Log
defaultParameters.description: Keep a rolling log in Saves/qtb-log.json.

defaultParameters.name: Battle Log Entries
defaultParameters.description: Maximum log entries kept.

commands.name: Set enabled
commands.description:
To turn Action Battle animations off mid-game:
Run a Command > Structure > Plugin > Set Enabled OFF

defaultParameters.name: value
defaultParameters.description: Enable quick-time challenges
